text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock B and Stock C after gains, but those gains alone don’t show that selling was the right call; past price changes don’t predict what comes next.","I tend to treat each stock as a separate account and resist admitting a losing purchase was a mistake. I’ll judge positions by their future prospects, not by whether they’re above my average cost.","I’ll make trade decisions using the portfolio as a whole and a deliberate plan, rather than trading just because I check prices often."]}
